# TestScript for 06-flag-constraints
# Asserts XOR groups, and groups, required flags, range (int, duration, byte size), len, items, and enum constraints,
# plus full-help rendering on usage errors (UsageOnError(UsageFull)) and the exit-code contract (exit 2)

# 1. Valid default run (required flag supplied)
exec constraints-demo -k s3cr3t-key
stdout '⚙  constraints-demo'
stdout '--port\s+int\s+8080\s+· default'
stdout '--timeout\s+time\.Duration\s+2s\s+· default'
stdout '--memory\s+conga\.ByteSize\s+256\.00 MiB\s+· default'
stdout '--env\s+string\s+dev\s+· default'
stdout '-k, --api-key\s+string\s+s3cr3t-key\s+● cli --api-key'
stdout 'Validated Constraints: format=default env=dev port=8080 timeout=2s memory=256\.00 MiB zones=0 api_key_source=cli'

# 2. Missing required flag fails with exit code 2 and renders the full help screen
exit-status 2 constraints-demo
stderr 'missing required flag: --api-key'
stderr '-k, --api-key=STRING'
stderr 'Usage:'
stderr 'Port number \[1\.\.65535\]'

# 3. Valid single XOR flag
exec constraints-demo -k s3cr3t-key --json
stdout '--json\s+bool\s+true\s+● cli --json'
stdout 'Validated Constraints: format=json env=dev port=8080 timeout=2s memory=256\.00 MiB zones=0 api_key_source=cli'

# 4. XOR Mutual Exclusion violation
exit-status 2 constraints-demo -k s3cr3t-key --json --yaml
stderr 'flags --json and --yaml are mutually exclusive'

# 5. And group violation (username without password)
exit-status 2 constraints-demo -k s3cr3t-key -u alice
stderr 'must be provided together'

# 6. And group satisfied
exec constraints-demo -k s3cr3t-key -u alice --password secretpass123
stdout '-u, --username\s+string\s+alice\s+● cli --username'
stdout '--password\s+string\s+secretpass123\s+● cli --password'

# 7. Len lower-bound violation (username shorter than 3 characters)
exit-status 2 constraints-demo -k s3cr3t-key -u al --password secretpass123
stderr 'value "al" length 2 is out of range \[3\.\.20\] for flag --username'

# 8. Len lower-bound violation (password shorter than 8 characters)
exit-status 2 constraints-demo -k s3cr3t-key -u alice --password short
stderr 'value "short" length 5 must be >= 8 for flag --password'

# 9. Numeric range violation (port > 65535)
exit-status 2 constraints-demo -k s3cr3t-key -p 70000
stderr 'value 70000 is out of range \[1\.\.65535\] for flag --port'

# 10. Duration range violation (timeout > 5s)
exit-status 2 constraints-demo -k s3cr3t-key --timeout 10s
stderr 'value 10s is out of range \[100ms\.\.5s\] for flag --timeout'

# 11. Byte size range violation (memory > 1GiB)
exit-status 2 constraints-demo -k s3cr3t-key --memory 2GiB
stderr 'value 2147483648 is out of range \[1MiB\.\.1GiB\] for flag --memory'

# 12. Enum violation
exit-status 2 constraints-demo -k s3cr3t-key --env local
stderr 'must be one of'

# 13. Collection bounds violation (4 items > max 3)
exit-status 2 constraints-demo -k s3cr3t-key -z us-east,us-west,eu-west,ap-south
stderr 'item count 4 is out of range \[2\.\.3\]'

# 14. Collection bounds violation (1 item < min 2)
exit-status 2 constraints-demo -k s3cr3t-key -z us-east
stderr 'item count 1 is out of range \[2\.\.3\]'
